tools.name: get_prospects
tools.description: Read rows from the FlowPilot Leads table (the central lead database). Use it before saving to avoid duplicate domains, and to answer Stellan's questions about leads, statuses, replies and follow-ups.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Only when Stellan explicitly asks in chat: change a lead's status in the FlowPilot Leads table and optionally Stellan's notes, matched by domain. Allowed statuses: NEEDS_REVIEW, SKIPPED, SUPPRESSED, MEETING_BOOKED, CUSTOMER. Never set APPROVED, SENT or SENDING; the Composer and Sender manage those.

tasks.name: Weekday prospecting run
tasks.objective: Do today's prospecting run as described in your instructions, with these current rules taking priority over anything older in them: the table is now FlowPilot Leads (get_prospects and save_prospect use it); new rows are saved with status NEW; record email_source_url (the page on the business's own site where public_email is printed). First read the table with get_prospects, then find and research up to 8 new home-service prospects and 2 new referral partners in the target towns (rotate towns and segments, preferring ones least represented), and save each new domain once with evidence, the v1 score and a short draft_note. Do NOT write outreach emails: the FlowPilot Composer workflow researches each NEW lead, writes the email, has an independent AI critic check it, and saves a Gmail draft for Stellan. Do NOT send anything, do NOT use the Gmail tool, and do NOT change any status. End with a short summary: number saved, the top 3 by score, and any problems.

note: Agent config export; the instructions field is omitted because it contains Stellan's pasted ACE operating document. Draft updated 2026-10-12 to use FlowPilot Leads; the published version may lag until republished.
